title: Define the weather model and observations
description: You connect named states and observations to the model's numeric arrays.

steps.description: You define Rainy and Sunny states and three observation names. A stores transitions, B stores observation probabilities, and pi stores initial state probabilities.
You construct HMM from these arrays and names. The selected observation sequence is walk, shop, clean.

steps.question: Which numeric sequence represents walk, shop, clean in this model?
steps.answer: The lookup produces [0,1,2], following the observation names' defined order.

steps.description: You print the numeric sequence beside its original names. The recorded output confirms both representations in the same order.
